page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.large is a shared-core virtual instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor within the ecs.s6 server family. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. It provides 2 shared virtual CPUs, meaning physical CPU compute cycles are shared among multiple virtual environments without dedicated core pinning.

The hardware profile includes 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM allocation of 4.0 GB per virtual core. It includes no bundled local storage, requiring external block storage for persistent filesystems and operating system volumes. Network specifications feature a baseline bandwidth of 0 Gbps and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and the configuration contains no hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Because the compute allocation is shared, the instance delivers budget-focused resource efficiency at the expense of consistent CPU performance under sustained multi-tenant contention. The 1:4 memory allocation makes it appropriate for non-critical workloads, lightweight web servers, background task runners, small staging environments, and entry-level development or testing nodes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.large is a budget-tier virtual machine from the shared ecs.s6 instance series running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 2 shared vCPUs on a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor alongside 8.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB per core. The server includes no local disk storage, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and no dedicated graphical processing units. Because vCPU resources are shared with other tenants on the physical host, processing consistency can vary under heavy neighbor load. The configuration offers cost-efficient compute density tailored for lightweight development environments, low-traffic web applications, microservices, and general testing workloads that do not require dedicated execution threads or high sustained throughput.
